mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 7.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), a rising federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity and reduced corporate output, which lowers earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in residential construction starts (HOUST) below 700,000 units signals a cooling housing market, which reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 700.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year indicates persistent inflation, which prompts the Federal Reserve to maintain a restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 100,000 monthly additions signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS falls below 100.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
